title: comfy docs *
description: Output shape for local documentation search and section retrieval. Fields are optional because search and show return different payloads.

query.description: The plain-text query passed to docs search.

has_more.description: Whether additional results exist beyond the requested limit (search).

search_backend.description: Search backend used; none means the query contained no searchable terms.

fallback_reason.description: Why auto mode used core BM25 instead of LanceDB hybrid retrieval.

hint.description: A suggested next step for a no-hit query or an unavailable optional mode.

id.description: Section ID accepted by docs show.

source_line.description: One-based heading line in the source file.

content.description: The Markdown section, or one requested page of it (show).

total_chars.description: Section content length in Unicode characters (show).

offset.description: Starting character offset of this page (show).

truncated.description: Whether more section content is available (show).

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page, or null when the section is complete (show).

corpus_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the installed documentation corpus.

highest_vector_similarity.description: Highest cosine similarity among vector candidates, when semantic search ran.

fts_term_coverage.description: Fraction of meaningful query terms found in the best lexical candidate.

score.description: Mode-specific lexical, cosine, or fused relevance score.
